note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 12 corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation, operations, or release.

evidence_classes.title: Documentary definition
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: A ratified, source-controlled document exists and defines the obligation.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: A documented obligation is not evidence that the obligation is met.
evidence_classes.independence_requirement: Author-verified; no independence required for definition.
evidence_classes.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated when the referenced requirement changes.

evidence_classes.title: Implementation evidence
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: Source, build, and dependency provenance bound to a version and commit.
evidence_classes.permitted_claim: A specified implementation was built from a specified source.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: Implementation existence is not verification and is not conformance.
evidence_classes.minimum_provenance: Version, commit, build record, and dependency manifest.
evidence_classes.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated on any source or dependency change.

evidence_classes.title: Automated test evidence
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: Automated results bound to version, configuration, environment, and data context.
evidence_classes.permitted_claim: Specified automated checks executed with a recorded result.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: A passing automated check is not complete conformance or operational readiness.
evidence_classes.minimum_provenance: Test identity, version, environment, data context, and result artifact.
evidence_classes.independence_requirement: Peer review of test scope and result.
evidence_classes.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated when code, configuration, or data context changes.

evidence_classes.title: Manual test evidence
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: Manual procedure, executor, observation, and data context recorded.
evidence_classes.permitted_claim: A specified manual procedure was executed with a recorded observation.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: A manual observation is not an automated guarantee of repeatability.
evidence_classes.minimum_provenance: Procedure identity, executor, environment, and observation record.
evidence_classes.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated when the procedure or system changes.

evidence_classes.title: Independent-review evidence
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: Review by an authority independent of the evidence owner and executor.
evidence_classes.permitted_claim: An independent reviewer reached a recorded conclusion.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: An independent review is not a substitute for the underlying evidence.
evidence_classes.minimum_provenance: Reviewer identity, independence level, inputs reviewed, and conclusion.
evidence_classes.independence_requirement: Independent of owner, executor, and acceptance authority.

evidence_classes.title: Migration evidence
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: Migration stage, batch, provenance, and reconciliation recorded.
evidence_classes.permitted_claim: A specified migration stage executed with recorded reconciliation.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: Migration execution is not migration acceptance or source retirement.
evidence_classes.minimum_provenance: Stage identity, batch, source authority, and reconciliation record.
evidence_classes.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated when source or mapping changes.

evidence_classes.title: Operational exercise evidence
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: Exercise scope, environment, provider state, and observed result recorded.
evidence_classes.permitted_claim: A specified operational exercise executed with a recorded result.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: An operational exercise is not operational readiness or release authorization.
evidence_classes.minimum_provenance: Exercise identity, environment, provider state, and result artifact.
evidence_classes.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated when environment or provider state changes.

evidence_classes.title: Provider evidence
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: Provider assertion bound to a certification scope and effective period.
evidence_classes.permitted_claim: A provider asserted a certified state within a defined scope.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: A provider certification is not end-to-end institutional proof.
evidence_classes.minimum_provenance: Provider identity, certification scope, effective period, and artifact.
evidence_classes.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated on provider state change or certification expiry.

evidence_classes.title: Business-acceptance evidence
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: Accountable business owner decision bound to reviewed evidence.
evidence_classes.permitted_claim: An accountable business owner accepted a defined outcome.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: Business acceptance is not operational acceptance or release authorization.
evidence_classes.minimum_provenance: Decision authority, reviewed evidence, conditions, and dissent record.
evidence_classes.independence_requirement: Business owner independent of technical delivery.
evidence_classes.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated on scope or evidence change.

evidence_classes.title: Executive-decision evidence
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: Executive decision bound to a decision brief and reviewed evidence.
evidence_classes.permitted_claim: An executive authority reached a recorded decision on reviewed evidence.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: Executive approval is not a substitute for the underlying evidence.
evidence_classes.minimum_provenance: Executive authority, decision brief, conditions, and dissent record.
evidence_classes.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated when the decision brief changes materially.

evidence_classes.title: Release evidence
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: Release authorization bound to an accepted, gated release candidate.
evidence_classes.permitted_claim: A release authority authorized a defined release candidate.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: Release authorized is not deployment executed.
evidence_classes.minimum_provenance: Release authority, release candidate identity, gate status, and conditions.
evidence_classes.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated if the release candidate changes.

evidence_classes.title: Production and stabilization evidence
evidence_classes.authoritative_requirement: Post-deployment observation bound to a deployed version and period.
evidence_classes.permitted_claim: A deployed release behaved in a recorded way during a stabilization period.
evidence_classes.prohibited_inference: Deployment completed is not service stabilized or institutional outcome accepted.
evidence_classes.minimum_provenance: Deployed version, observation window, and post-deployment obligation record.
evidence_classes.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated at the close of each stabilization window.
